description: Generate an AI image via Templated's image pipeline and get back a hosted HTTPS URL to embed in template HTML (e.g. a hero image). UNLIKE template creation, this DOES consume the account's monthly AI image credits — it runs on Templated's image model. Paid plans only; free accounts get a plan-limit error. Use real photography or brand assets when the user has them; generate when they don't.

aspect.description: Aspect ratio (default '1:1'). Use '16:9' for hero banners.

prompt.description: Image description (3–2000 chars). Be specific about subject, style, and mood.

template_id.description: Optional template UUID to attach the image to (exempts it from orphan cleanup).

name: generate_image
